breaks.quote: Even her nutritionist once told her that if she were really consistent she would see results every week
breaks.why: Melina's story was already told whole, and this new scene arrives on a return trip after the break, so the reader gets a second telling with new pieces added.

breaks.quote: So what I realised is, that’s why I almost never finish anything.
breaks.why: The passage opens on Melina's realisation, the ending of her story, before the story earns it, then repeats it when it finally arrives.

breaks.quote: It looks easy on other people. I guess I just can’t.
breaks.why: The sentence is set apart and then re-set after the divider to restart Melina's arc, so the reader meets the same story twice.
